# Joel Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 333v–334r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/JOL_002_page_001.jpg

---

**2:1** Blow [tiq'u] a-trumpet [shofar] in-Tsiyon [Zion], and-sound-an-alarm [vehari'u] on-my-holy [qodshi] mountain [har]; let-all the-inhabitants of-the-land tremble [yirgezu]; for coming [ba] [is] the-day of-YHWH, for [it is] near [qarov]:

**2:2** A-day of-darkness [choshekh] and-gloom [afelah], a-day of-cloud [anan] and-thick-darkness [arafel]; like-dawn [ke-shachar] spread [parush] upon the-mountains — a-people [am] great [rav] and-mighty [atsum]; the-like-of-it [kamohu] has-not been [lo nihyah] from-eternity [min-ha-olam], and-after-it [acharav] there-will-not be [lo yosaf] until the-years of-generation [dor] and-generation.

**2:3** Before-it [lefanav] fire [esh] devours [akhelah], and-behind-it [acharav] flame [lehavah] consumes [telahhet]; like-the-garden [ke-gan] of-Eden [Eden] the-land [ha-arets] before-it [lefanav], and-behind-it [acharav] a-wilderness [midbar] of-desolation [shemamah]; and-also [gam] there-is-no [ein] escape [peletah] from-it [lo].

**2:4** Like-the-appearance [ke-mar'eh] of-horses [susim] [is] its-appearance, and-like-horsemen [ke-farashim] so [ken] they-run [yerutsun]. **2:5** Like-the-sound [ke-qol] of-chariots [markovot] on the-tops [rashei] of-the-mountains they-leap [yeraqqedun], like-the-sound of-a-flame [lahav] of-fire [esh] devouring [okhelet] stubble [qash], like-a-people [am] mighty [atsum] arrayed [arukh] for-battle [milchamah].

**2:6** Before-it [mi-panav] peoples [ammim] writhe [yachilu]; all faces [panim] gather [qibetsu] a-glow [pa'rur].

**2:7** Like-warriors [ke-gibborim] they-run [yerutsun]; like-men of-war [anshei milchamah] they-go-up [ya'alu] a-wall [chomah]; and-each [ish] on-his-ways [bidrakhav] they-march [yelkhun], and-they-do-not twist [lo yeavtun] their-paths [orchotam].

**2:8** And-each [ish] his-brother [achivu] they-do-not press [lo yidchaqun]; each [gever] on-his-path [bimsilato] they-march [yelkhun]; and-through [be'ad] the-weapons [ha-shelach] they-fall [yippolu] and-are-not cut-off [lo yivtsa'u].

**2:9** In-the-city [ba-ir] they-rush [yashokku]; on-the-wall [ba-chomah] they-run [yerutsun]; into-the-houses [ba-battim] they-climb [ya'alu]; through the-windows [ha-challonot] they-enter [yavo'u] like-the-thief [ka-gannav].

**2:10** Before-it [lefanav] the-earth [erets] quakes [ragzah], the-heavens [shamayim] tremble [ra'ashu]; the-sun [shemesh] and-the-moon [yareach] grow-dark [qadru], and-the-stars [kokhavim] gather-in [asfu] their-brightness [nogham].

**2:11** And-YHWH gives [natan] his-voice [qolo] before [lifnei] his-army [cheilo]; for very [me'od] great [rav] [is] his-camp [machaneihu]; for mighty [atsum] [is he who] carries-out [oseh] his-word [devaro]; for great [gadol] [is] the-day of-YHWH and-very [me'od] terrible [nora]; and-who can-endure-it [mi yekhilenu]?

**2:12** "And-also now [gam attah]," declares [ne'um] YHWH, "return [shuvu] to-me with-all your-heart [levavkhem], and-with-fasting [tsom], and-with-weeping [bekhi], and-with-mourning [misped]."

**2:13** "And-tear [veqir'u] your-heart [levavkhem] and-not your-garments [bigdeikhem], and-return [veshuvu] to YHWH your-God [eloheikhem]; for gracious [channun] he [is] and-compassionate [verachum], slow [erekh] of-anger [appayim] and-great [rav] of-loyalty [chesed], and-relenting [venicham] concerning the-evil [ha-ra'ah]."

**2:14** Who knows [mi yode'a]? He-may-turn [yashuv] and-relent [venicham] and-leave [vehish'ir] behind-him [acharav] a-blessing [berakhah] — a-grain-offering [minchah] and-a-drink-offering [vanesekh] for-YHWH your-God.

**2:15** Blow [tiq'u] a-trumpet [shofar] in-Tsiyon; consecrate [qaddishu] a-fast [tsom], call [qir'u] an-assembly [atsarah]. **2:16** Gather [isfu] the-people [am], consecrate the-assembly [qahal], assemble [qibtsu] the-elders [zequnim], gather [isfu] the-children [olelim] and-nursing-ones [yonqei shadayim]; let-the-bridegroom [chatan] go-out [yetse] from-his-chamber [me-chedro] and-the-bride [kallah] from-her-canopy [me-chuppatah].

**2:17** Between the-porch [ha-ulam] and-the-altar [ha-mizbe'ach] let-the-priests [kohanim] weep [yivku], the-ministers of-YHWH, and-let-them-say [veyomru]: "Have-pity [chusah], YHWH, on-your-people [ammekha], and-do-not give [al-titten] your-inheritance [nachalatekha] to-reproach [le-cherpah], for-the-nations [goyim] to-rule [limshol] over-them. Why [lamah] should-they-say [yomeru] among-the-peoples [ba-ammim], 'Where [is] their-God [elohehem]?'"

**2:18** And-YHWH was-zealous [vayyeqannei] for-his-land [le-artso], and-had-pity [vayyachmol] on his-people [ammo].

**2:19** And-YHWH answered [vayyaan] and-said to-his-people: "Behold, I [am] sending [shole'ach] to-you the-grain [ha-dagan] and-the-new-wine [ha-tirosh] and-the-oil [ha-yitshar], and-you-will-be-satisfied [usvaatem] with-it; and-I-will-not make [lo etten] you again [od] a-reproach [cherpah] among-the-nations."

**2:20** "And-the-northerner [ha-tsefoni] I-will-remove-far [archiq] from-upon-you, and-drive-him [vehidachtivu] to a-land [erets] dry [tsiyyah] and-desolate [ushemamah]; his-face [panav] to the-sea the-eastern [ha-qadmoni], and-his-end [sofo] to the-sea the-western [ha-acharon]; and-his-stench [u-va'asho] will-go-up [veyaal] and-his-foulness [vetaaleh tsa'anatho] will-go-up — for he-has-done [asah] great-things [le-hagdil la'asot]."

**2:21** "Do-not fear [al-tire'i], O-land [adamah]; rejoice [gili] and-be-glad [usmachi]; for YHWH has-done-great-things [higdil la'asot]."

**2:22** "Do-not fear [al-tire'u], O-beasts [bahemot] of-the-field [sadai]; for the-pastures [ne'ot] of-the-wilderness [midbar] have-sprouted [dashe'u]; for the-tree [ets] has-borne [nasa] its-fruit [piryo]; the-fig-tree [te'enah] and-the-vine [gefen] have-given [natnu] their-strength [cheilam]."

**2:23** "And-sons of-Tsiyon [Zion], rejoice [gilu] and-be-glad [vismchu] in-YHWH your-God; for he-has-given [natan] to-you the-early-rain [ha-moreh] for-righteousness [li-tsdaqah]; and-he-causes-to-come-down [vayyored] for-you rain [geshem] — early-rain [moreh] and-latter-rain [u-malqosh] in-the-first [month] [ba-rishon]."

**2:24** "And-the-threshing-floors [ha-goranot] will-be-full [umale'u] of-grain [bar], and-the-vats [ha-yeqavim] will-overflow [veheshiqu] [with] new-wine and-oil."

**2:25** "And-I-will-restore [veshillamti] to-you the-years [ha-shanim] which the-swarming-locust [ha-arbeh] has-eaten [akhal], the-hopping-locust [ha-yeleq] and-the-destroying-locust [he-chasil] and-the-cutting-locust [ha-gazam] — my-great army [cheili ha-gadol] which I-sent [shillachti] among-you."

**2:26** "And-you-will-eat [vaakhaltem], eating [akhol] and-being-satisfied [vesavo'a], and-you-will-praise [vehilaltem] the-name of-YHWH your-God who has-dealt [asah] with-you wondrously [lehafli]; and-my-people [ammi] will-not be-ashamed [lo yevoshu] forever [le-olam]."

**2:27** "And-you-will-know [vidaatem] that in-the-midst [be-qerev] of-Yisra'el [Israel] I [am], and-I [am] YHWH your-God and-there-is-no other [ein od]; and-my-people will-not be-ashamed forever."

**2:28** "And-it-will-be [vehayah] afterwards [acharei-khen], I-will-pour-out [eshpokh] my-spirit [ruchi] on all flesh [kol basar]; and-your-sons [beneikhem] and-your-daughters [uvnoteikhem] will-prophesy [venibei'u]; your-elders [ziqneikhem] dreams [chalomot] will-dream [yachalomun]; your-young-men [bachureikhem] visions [chezyonot] will-see [yir'u]."

**2:29** "And-also on the-servants [ha-avadim] and-on the-maidservants [ha-shefachot] in-those days [ba-yammim ha-hemmah] I-will-pour-out my-spirit."

**2:30** "And-I-will-give [venatati] wonders [mofetim] in-the-heavens [ba-shamayim] and-on-the-earth [u-va-arets]: blood [dam] and-fire [esh] and-columns [vetimrot] of-smoke [ashan]."

**2:31** "The-sun [ha-shemesh] will-be-turned [yehafekh] to-darkness [le-choshekh], and-the-moon [ha-yareach] to-blood [le-dam], before the-coming [lifnei bo] of-the-day of-YHWH, the-great [ha-gadol] and-the-terrible [ve-ha-nora]."

**2:32** "And-it-will-be [vehayah], everyone [kol] who calls [yiqra] on-the-name of-YHWH will-be-delivered [yimmalet]; for on-Mount Tsiyon and-in-Yerushalayim [Jerusalem] there-will-be deliverance [peletah], as YHWH has-said [amar], and-among-the-survivors [u-vasseridim] whom YHWH calls [qore]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — "like dawn spread upon the mountains":** The army is compared to dawn — a spreading, unstoppable advance across the ridgelines. The imagery shifts between locust plague and military invasion throughout.

**v.13 — The creedal formula:** Joel 2:13 quotes the same Exodus 34:6 formula as Jonah 4:2 — "gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in *chesed*." But while Jonah cites it as a complaint, Joel cites it as hope.

**v.23 — "the early rain for righteousness":** *Ha-moreh li-tsdaqah* is notoriously difficult. *Moreh* can mean "teacher" or "early rain." The phrase may mean "the teacher of righteousness" (cf. the Dead Sea Scrolls' *Moreh ha-Tsedeq*) or "the rain for vindication."

**v.28-29 — The spirit poured out:** In the Hebrew Bible (Joel 3:1-2), these verses begin chapter 3. English Bibles follow the LXX chapter division. Peter quotes this passage at Pentecost (Acts 2:17-21) as fulfilled prophecy.

*— EMET*
